name: EPIC 201188641
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.6 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201188641 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.565171 (16th-84th percentiles 7.40778-7.815341), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201188641 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.871612 (16th-84th percentiles 0.825716-0.950692), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201188641: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4684.223 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201188641 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2432.324219 (16th-84th percentiles 2389.707031-2489.277344), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.02 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,432 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.87 solar masses and 7.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,684 K at its surface.
